whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Boring Café,

I noticed your café has fantastic 4.1★ reviews with over 1,500 happy patrons on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile web page for table reservations and menu discovery.

Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature menu showcase, aur ambience gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/boringcafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Boring Café, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, menu highlights, and your prime location on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
